name: Qwen 3.8 27B

attrs.author: Cerebras
attrs.summary: This model excels at vision-language understanding, coding, research, and long-horizon agentic tasks.

notes: Chat Completions returns text only. The Completions endpoint does not support images, reasoning controls, structured chat messages, or tools.

Image inputs are supported only through Chat Completions and must be base64-encoded PNG or JPEG data URIs. External image URLs, image detail controls, image generation, video, and audio are not supported. See the Image Inputs guide.
Reasoning is enabled by default at high. Set reasoning_effort to none to disable it. See the reasoning guide.
Structured outputs and tool calling with strict: true are supported. See the Structured Outputs guide for current schema support and limitations.
